failure_categories.label: 输入错误
failure_categories.block_rule: Required source, file, audience, scope, or permission is missing.

failure_categories.label: 路由错误
failure_categories.block_rule: Simple task was over-orchestrated or complex task was treated as one-shot.

failure_categories.label: Schema错误
failure_categories.block_rule: Required fields, contracts, or node outputs are missing or invalid.

failure_categories.label: 组件错误
failure_categories.block_rule: Required UI, visual, page, or artifact components are missing or not replaceable/editable when required.

failure_categories.label: 渲染错误
failure_categories.block_rule: Layout, visual render, PDF export, canvas, or browser output fails acceptance criteria.

failure_categories.label: QA缺失
failure_categories.block_rule: A key artifact bypassed validation or lacks a QA gate result.

failure_categories.label: 事实口径错误
failure_categories.block_rule: Unsupported, stale, or polluted facts are used as if verified.

failure_categories.label: 格式交付错误
failure_categories.block_rule: Delivered format does not match the requested type, path, editability, or portability.

failure_categories.label: 领域适配错误
failure_categories.block_rule: Domain-specific rules were applied globally or omitted when task context required them.

failure_categories.label: 工具模型可用性错误
failure_categories.block_rule: Unavailable tools or future model aliases are claimed as available.

failure_categories.label: 绑定错误
failure_categories.block_rule: A selected node references unregistered or unavailable skill/tool/model ids.

failure_categories.label: 产物合同错误
failure_categories.block_rule: Required intermediate or final artifacts are missing from the artifact contract or delivery manifest.

failure_categories.label: 恢复回滚错误
failure_categories.block_rule: Rollback or restart from node would discard confirmed upstream artifacts or retain invalid downstream artifacts.
